name: AK16DAH-CO - Indoor Air Quality Monitor (CO2, CO, TVOC, HCHO, PM1.0, PM2.5, PM10, Temperature, Humidity), NDIR & Electrochemical Sensors, App Connected
highlights: The AK16DA-CO With Nothing Left Unticked — The app version with its sensing taken to the top tier: infrared NDIR CO₂, electrochemical formaldehyde and electrochemical carbon monoxide. Every item on the AK16 option list is checked.
Nothing Left on the Options List — Buyers who compare specification tables tend to buy the row with no empty cells. This is that row.
A Complete Record for a Combustion Environment — Gas, particulate and CO history exported from one device, for the rooms where all three matter at once.
2000 mAh, Six Hours — Three-hour USB-C charge, 249 g, same 24 mm panel as the entry model.
One Enclosure, Nine Configurations — Buyers move up and down the AK16 range without a change to packaging, carton quantity or freight class.
